concept.title: System architecture
concept.shortdesc: runs on AWS and is served over HTTPS.

conbody.p: The application consists of the following components:

ul.li: Web server: Hosts the application and handles requests.
Database: Stores portfolio and price data.
DNS and TLS: Routes traffic to the custom domain over HTTPS.

conbody.p: Infrastructure is being migrated to Terraform, with CloudFront planned as the CDN layer.
